summary: The customer contacted customer support to check if their prescription delivery is still scheduled for today. However, due to a winter storm affecting the region, the order has been delayed. The customer was in urgent need of the medication, and the representative suggested picking it up at a nearby pharmacy, arranging a same-day transfer, and holding the item in stock for the customer to collect. If the customer is unable to make it to the pharmacy, the pickup window can be extended until the following day, and no extra charge will apply if the original package is lost. The representative also enabled SMS updates for the customer to keep them informed on the status of the transfer.
